descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-94745 AC 3, AC 4, AC 7 · “No patient data is stored on the device to support offline use (minimal session cache only, per SOW)”. Mixed: stated part — (c) no device copy once the server has the text, (d) interrupted recording kept and handed over; our part — (a)/(b) Save Note interrupted by a reload or by opening the next patient (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug B27 · S2 · new (partly known)

Failure states give the wrong or no guidance: after an interrupted pre-round save the Encounter tab keeps the physician waiting for the panels while the Pre-Round tab says to tap Save Note; an interrupted Nursing Home Save Note says the text was edited; a red 'disconnected' error stays after dictation recovered; a failed Quick Dictation transcription shows only the raw server error, no '⚠ what to do'; with the microphone blocked it still says 'Dictation done — review before saving'; Post-Round shows 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' forever for a Hospital patient with no note yet

Tickets: TFA-94745 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94745/92582): EFS/S06: the Encounter tab does say the panels are still being processed; the fault is that the processing had stopped. TC-04/S28: on a 429 the only thing on screen is the raw server error (B17's kind), and S28 covers only the batch (whisper) path, not a gpt-live failure. EFS/S22: 'Dictation done' with the microphone blocked (UAT state 8). EFS/S02 and TC-20/S24: the endless 'Finalizing…' spinner D7 points to.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): EFS/S06, TC-23/S08, TC-04/S28, EFS/S17, TC-17/S19

Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S29 Interrupted work: a Save Note cut off by a reload or by opening the next patient, a recording that drops, and what stays on the device afterwards

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 If the summary call fails: the raw dictation is kept, an explicit error shows, and Generate is disabled until a Save succeeds (PR #53). Yesterday's panels are never silently reused. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 8; TFA-94745 state 3; UAT Empty & Failure States)
  • T4 The summary-failed state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's style (never a blank screen, crash, raw error pop-up or invented content), loses nothing typed or dictated, appears only af … (TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT 3.5)
  • T7 A voice failure in the pre-round notes or Important Points channel loses nothing: a live recording is kept until its transcript is in the field (PR #95); … (TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 comment 2026-10-05)
  • T8 No patient data is stored on the device beyond a minimal session cache: only the unsaved tail of a pre-round dictation (IndexedDB 'roundcompanion-session-drafts', src/lib/localDrafts.ts; … (TFA-94745 AC 7; TFA-94745 comment 2026-10-05)
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given A fresh @roundai.test account with two Hospital patients (A, B) and two Nursing Home residents (A, B); ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes held about 8 s for A; the four existing e2e/unit recording specs

When (a) Save Note on A, reload during the hold. (b) Save Note on A, go back to the list and open B during the hold. (c) After a successful Save Note, read IndexedDB 'roundcompanion-session-drafts' and the local audio store; sign out and read them again. …

Then (a) A shows 'structured processing was interrupted. Tap Save Note to continue', the text is kept, Generate is disabled. (b) A ends either updated with A's values or with that message (never silently stale); B's panels and tasks stay empty and show none of A's values. (c) No row for the chart once the server has the text; both stores empty after sign-out. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions from U6/T4 for (a)/(b), T8 for (c) (TFA-94745 AC 7 and Quinn's 2026-10-05 comment: only the unsaved tail, wiped on sign-out; PHI at rest is Q16), T7 for (d). On (b), B showing any of A's distinctive values (124/72, 15.1, Ceftriaxone 1; 138/76, 9.8) is a Fail

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S29 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92588 ready for qa; TFA-94745 ready for qa

In Nursing Home, a Save Note cut off by a reload shows no 'interrupted' message. The only hint says the pre-round text was edited after it was processed, which the physician did not do.

Evidence: allure b4241dc3: (a) passes in Hospital and fails in NH; (b) and (d) pass. The gates (U6/T4/U10) are ungated, judged now. Not in the dev report or the ledger: ledger U59 (EFS S06 on dev) covers only the Hospital Encounter tab in state B and checked NH only for A and D. A second finding (c): the saved text stays in IndexedDB 'roundcompanion-session-drafts', and 'round-ai-local-audio' survives sign-out. That part is TC-10 Q16 / TFA-94745 open point A (PHI at rest), for Daniela to decide.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
